title: Presheaf tensor product of modules
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, let $\mathcal O$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$, and let $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ be presheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Their presheaf tensor product $\mathcal F\otimes_{p,\mathcal O}\mathcal G$ is the presheaf of modules whose value on each object $U$ is $\mathcal F(U)\otimes_{\mathcal O(U)}\mathcal G(U)$ and whose restriction along a morphism $V\to U$ is the map induced by the restriction maps of $\mathcal F$, $\mathcal G$, and $\mathcal O$.
